Restore aggregated divide areas dropped by PRD / aggregation

Source: R/repairs.R
restore_aggregated_divides.Rd

Two kinds of area-loss can affect an aggregated divide between the reference NHD input and the final output:

  1. Aggregation-stage loss: the aggregate-to-distribution step internally runs hfutils::clean_geometry on the aggregated divides, whose small-part glue logic can crush a reconciled-split-sibling polygon (e.g. the .2 half of an reference COMID) to a ~100 m2 residual. Detected by comparing each aggregated cat's area to the sum of its member reconciled-divide areas (from rec_div).

  2. PRD-stage loss: the refactor-split may drop one of the split children entirely (typically a narrow sliver that falls below a cleanup threshold inside reconcile_divides), so its area never appears in rec_div at all. The sibling's divide survives; the lost half vanishes into no catchment. Detected only when reference_divides is supplied, by comparing the aggregated cat's area to the sum of reference NHD divide areas for its member COMIDs.

Whichever reference is larger (rec_div-based or reference-based) wins. Shortfalls beyond threshold trigger a rebuild from the union of:

  • rec_div geometries for members whose reconciled divide exists, plus

  • reference-divide geometries for members missing from rec_div (the PRD dropouts). Divide polygons are not otherwise modified.

Usage

restore_aggregated_divides(
  input_gpkg,
  rec_div,
  reference_divides = NULL,
  threshold = 0.9,
  abs_shortfall_m2 = 10000,
  split_gap_m2 = 5e+05,
  divide_layer = "divides",
  network_layer = "network",
  verbose = FALSE
)

Arguments

input_gpkg

Path to the intermediate GeoPackage (contains divides and network layers).

rec_div

sf object of reconciled divides returned by reconcile_divides() (before aggregation). Must contain flowpath_id (= reconciled integer ID) and geometry.

reference_divides

Optional sf of reference NHD divides (the pipeline's pre-refactor input). Must contain divide_id (the reference COMID as character) and geometry. When supplied, enables detection of PRD-stage drops where a split child was never produced.

threshold

Fraction. Aggregated divides with area < threshold * max( expected_rec, expected_ref) are restored. Default 0.95.

abs_shortfall_m2

numeric (m^2). A divide is also restored when its absolute area shortfall vs expected exceeds this, catching small-percentage gaps on large divides. Default 1e4.

split_gap_m2

numeric (m^2). Minimum reference-divide gap area that qualifies as a genuine PRD split dropout worth filling. Default 5e5.

divide_layer

Name of the divides layer. Default "divides".

network_layer

Name of the network layer. Default "network".

verbose

If TRUE, emit a per-divide breakdown of area shortfalls and recovery deltas, plus a source-breakdown (rec_div / ref / both) per fix.

Value

Invisibly, character vector of restored aggregated divide ids.
